MUNICIPAL REGULATORY BYLAWS - 2026
Chapter 1: Statutory Operational Provisions

Section 1.1: Administrative Authority and Jurisdiction
Under the powers conferred by the Local Government Enabling Act,
the municipal council hereby establishes the standards of Chapter 1.

1. Every registered property owner shall comply with municipal codes;
2. Applications must be submitted in writing with certified architectural drawings;
3. Inspections shall be conducted during normal business hours.

(a) Residential permits expire twelve months from date of issuance;
(b) Commercial zoning variances require public hearing notifications;
(c) Appeals must be lodged within 30 days of the decision date.
MUNICIPAL REGULATORY BYLAWS - 2026
